body:
CAPZ uses `envsubt` to update templated files with specific K8s versions.
Without this being kube-proxy images aren't able to get scheduled due to this env var not being expanded

```log
E0504 21:58:46.448218    4984 pod_workers.go:747] "Error syncing pod, skipping" err="failed to \"StartContainer\" for \"kube-proxy\" with InvalidImageName: \"Failed to apply default image tag \\\"sigwindowstools/kube-proxy:${KUBERNETES_VERSION/+/_}-calico-hostprocess\\\": couldn't parse image reference \\\"sigwindowstools/kube-proxy:${KUBERNETES_VERSION/+/_}-calico-hostprocess\\\": invalid reference format\"" pod="kube-system/kube-proxy-windows-lf664" podUID=fb40eb05-000b-420c-bd29-bcfad4d86bf4
```

From https://storage.googleapis.com/kubernetes-jenkins/pr-logs/pull/perf-tests/2051/soak-tests-capz-windows-2019/1521965516254613504/artifacts/workload-cluster/capz-de0b-tb9j2/kubelet.exe.ERROR

/assign @jsturtevant @oprinmarius

Related to https://github.com/kubernetes/perf-tests/pull/2051
title: Set KUBERNETES_VERSION env var for soak-tests-capz-windows-2019
